title: Inspiration4 whole blood: complete blood count (plus restricted/raw omics not downloaded)
what_it_contains: Quest Diagnostics CBC for 4 civilian crew at 7 pre/post-flight timepoints (hemoglobin, WBC, platelets, etc.) with reference ranges. Merged into labs_long.csv.
license_access: Unrestricted processed files; no login. Public NASA OSDR download.

title: Inspiration4 PBMC profiling: snRNA-seq, snATAC-seq, and T/B-cell repertoire
what_it_contains: Processed Excel tables of PBMC gene expression, chromatin accessibility, and VDJ results. Raw FASTQ skipped (sequencing).
license_access: Unrestricted processed files; no login. Public NASA OSDR download. Raw sequences not included.

title: Inspiration4 plasma: proteomics, EVPs, and metabolomics
what_it_contains: Processed plasma/EVP proteomics and plasma metabolomics tables plus sample metadata. Skipped 61 MB preprocessed TSV (duplicate of processed XLSX) and raw/cfDNA sequencing.
license_access: Unrestricted processed files; no login. Public NASA OSDR download.

title: Inspiration4 blood serum: comprehensive metabolic panel and cytokine arrays
what_it_contains: CMP (glucose, electrolytes, kidney/liver markers) with reference ranges; Eve HD71 immune, Eve HDCVD9 cardiovascular, and Alamar NULISA serum cytokine tables. Merged into labs_long.csv.
license_access: Unrestricted processed files; no login. Public NASA OSDR download.

title: Inspiration4 oral, nasal, and skin microbial swabs (metagenomics summaries)
what_it_contains: Compact processed summaries only: MetaPhlan taxonomy and pathway abundances, plus README/metadata. Skipped raw sequences and gene-family TSVs over 200 MB.
license_access: Unrestricted processed files; no login. Public NASA OSDR download.

title: Inspiration4 Dragon capsule environmental swabs (metagenomics summaries)
what_it_contains: Compact processed summaries: MetaPhlan taxonomy and pathway abundances, plus README/metadata. Raw sequences skipped.
license_access: Unrestricted processed files; no login. Public NASA OSDR download.

title: Inspiration4 deltoid skin biopsy: spatial transcriptomics and skin microbiome summaries
what_it_contains: Processed spatial transcriptomics XLSX and MetaPhlan taxonomy summary. Per-sample metagenomics assembly TSVs and raw sequences skipped.
license_access: Unrestricted processed files; no login. Public NASA OSDR download.

title: Inspiration4 stool metagenome summaries
what_it_contains: Compact processed summaries: MetaPhlan taxonomy and pathway abundances, plus README/metadata. Raw sequences skipped.
license_access: Unrestricted processed files; no login. Public NASA OSDR download.

title: Inspiration4 urine inflammation panel (Alamar NULISAseq)
what_it_contains: Processed urine multiplex cytokine/inflammation NPQ values and target information. 22 of 28 possible crew-timepoint rows are present in the source. Merged into labs_long.csv.
license_access: Unrestricted processed files; no login. Public NASA OSDR download.

title: Inspiration4 T-cell histone modification profiling (H3K4me1, H3K4me3, H3K27ac)
what_it_contains: Study metadata only. All ChIC-seq/CUT&RUN sequence files are restricted and/or far larger than 200 MB; no public processed peak/count table was listed.
license_access: Metadata unrestricted. Sequence data are controlled-access / restricted on OSDR.

title: RR-9 mouse ocular microscopy (OS-568 experiment): blood-retinal barrier markers
what_it_contains: Processed ZO-1, TUNEL, and PECAM immunostaining tables from mice after a 35-day ISS mission. Not human clinical labs; not merged into labs_long.csv. Image zips skipped (large binary microscopy, many 50–150 MB).
license_access: Unrestricted processed tables; no login. Public NASA OSDR download.

title: RR-9 mouse intraocular pressure (tonometry); same OS-568 / RR-9 experiment
what_it_contains: Left/right eye IOP measurements (mmHg) for flight and ground-control mice. Analog for spaceflight-associated ocular risk. Not merged into the human labs_long.csv.
license_access: Unrestricted processed files; no login. Public NASA OSDR download.

title: RR-9 mouse retina proteomics; same OS-568 / RR-9 experiment
what_it_contains: Processed MaxQuant iBAQ retina proteomics XLSX (~23 MB). Raw instrument zips (~4 GB each) skipped.
license_access: Unrestricted processed file; no login. Public NASA OSDR download.

title: NASA RadLab ISS radiation dosimetry (DosTel)
what_it_contains: One week of ISS absorbed-dose-rate time series from DosTel1 and DosTel2, 2024-06-01 through 2024-06-07 (~2 min cadence). Combined in radiation_iss.csv. TEPC returned no rows for the instrument names tried. A 2024-01-01 week query for DosTel was empty (data not in API for that window).

title: NASA DONKI solar energetic particle events, calendar year 2024
what_it_contains: SEP event records (time, instruments, linked flares/CMEs, DONKI URLs) fetched in <=60-day windows and combined in donki_sep.csv.
license_access: Public CCMC DONKI API; no key or login required.

title: Official NASA list of Inspiration4 datasets in OSDR (checklist source)
what_it_contains: NASA page listing OSD-569, 570, 571, 575, 572, 573, 574, 630, 656, and 687. Used as the inclusion checklist; not a data file.
